## Spatial predictions of diarrhea and ATE
```{r}

#---------------------------
# identify the bounding box
# around subdistricts that
# contain the WASHB Bangladesh
# clusters
#---------------------------
b_boxgrid <- st_make_grid(niger_adm2,
                          n    = c(100,100),
                          what = "centers"
                          )

#-------------------------
# data frame for
# mortality spatial modeling
#-------------------------
grappe_gps_mort

#-------------------------
# fit spatial model for
# diarrhea prevalence in 
# the control group
#-------------------------
b_fitmort_1to59 <- spaMM::fitme(n_deaths_1to59 ~ 
                                  1 +
                                  lat + lon + 
                                  Matern(1|lat + lon) +
                                  (1|site_code),
                                resid.model = 
                                  list(formula=~0+offset(log(pt_year_1to59))),
                                data = grappe_gps_mort,
                                family = poisson(link = "log")
                          )

b_fitmort_1to11 <- spaMM::fitme(n_deaths_1to11 ~ 
                                  1 +
                                  lat + lon + 
                                  Matern(1|lat + lon) +
                                  (1|site_code),
                                resid.model = 
                                  list(formula=~0+offset(log(pt_year_1to11))),
                                data = grappe_gps_mort,
                                family = poisson(link = "log")
                          )

b_fitmort_12to59 <- spaMM::fitme(n_deaths_12to59 ~ 
                                  1 +
                                  lat + lon + 
                                  Matern(1|lat + lon) +
                                  (1|site_code),
                                resid.model = 
                                  list(formula=~0+offset(log(pt_year_12to59))),
                                data = grappe_gps_mort,
                                family = poisson(link = "log")
                          )
```


```{r}

plot_materncor_mort_1to59  <- plot_matern_corr(b_fitmort_1to59)
plot_materncor_mort_1to11  <- plot_matern_corr(b_fitmort_1to11)
plot_materncor_mort_12to59 <- plot_matern_corr(b_fitmort_12to59)

ggsave(filename=paste0(figure_path,"avenir-materncor-01to59.png"),
       plot=plot_materncor_mort_1to59,
       device="png",
       width=3.3,
       height=3.5)

ggsave(filename=paste0(figure_path,"avenir-materncor-01to11.png"),
       plot=plot_materncor_mort_1to11,
       device="png",
       width=3.3,
       height=3.5)

ggsave(filename=paste0(figure_path,"avenir-materncor-12to59.png"),
       plot=plot_materncor_mort_12to59,
       device="png",
       width=3.3,
       height=3.5)

```


```{r}
#--------------------------------------
# get model predictions on a grid
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_1to59 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
                                     spamm_model_fit = b_fitmort_1to59)

b_preds_mort_1to11 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid      = b_boxgrid,
                                     spamm_model_fit = b_fitmort_1to11)

b_preds_mort_12to59 <- get_grid_preds(input_grid     = b_boxgrid,
                                     spamm_model_fit = b_fitmort_12to59)

#--------------------------------------
# convert predicted surface of the mean
# to a raster to make it a regular
# set of tiles (rather than points), 
# then to tibble for ggplot2
# scale prevalence by 100
# to be in units of percent (%)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_coords_1to59  <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_1to59)
b_preds_mort_coords_1to11  <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_1to11)
b_preds_mort_coords_12to59 <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort_12to59)

b_preds_mort_raster_1to59 <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_1to59[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_1to59[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_1to59$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_1to11 <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_1to11[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_1to11[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_1to11$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster_12to59 <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords_12to59[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords_12to59[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort_12to59$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster2_1to59  <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_1to59)
b_preds_mort_raster2_1to11  <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_1to11)
b_preds_mort_raster2_12to59 <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster_12to59)

```
